sections.title: The Struggle of the Righteous
observations: The psalmist begins by expressing his struggle with the apparent prosperity of the wicked. He feels envious of their success and comfort, which leads him to question the justice of God.
This section highlights a common human experience: the struggle to reconcile faith with the reality of suffering and injustice in the world.

sections.title: The Turning Point
observations: The psalmist experiences a turning point when he enters the sanctuary of God. Here, he gains a new perspective on the fate of the wicked and the ultimate justice of God.
This emphasizes the importance of worship and community in understanding God's ways and finding solace in times of doubt.

sections.title: The Assurance of God's Justice
observations: The psalmist reflects on the destiny of the wicked, recognizing that their prosperity is temporary and that they will ultimately face judgment.
This section reassures believers that God is sovereign and just, and that the apparent success of the wicked is fleeting.

importantVerses.commentary: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then I understood their end.
But it is good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all Your works.

questions: What does this psalm teach us about the nature of envy and its impact on our faith?
How can entering into worship help us gain perspective on our struggles?
What does the psalmist's realization about the fate of the wicked reveal about God's justice?
